result.summary: Verdict FAIL. Scope: .claude/agents/, all 37 role files, compared with the originals in a fresh clone of the tag base/TRANSL-20261025-01. Result in plain words: the translation is faithful. I read all 37 files section by section next to the Russian original (2,448 paired blocks of headings, paragraphs, list items, table rows and code blocks) and found no lost, added or changed rule, number, condition, step, example or identifier. Four small defects remain, all of them cheap to fix, and they block under the common severity scale (Medium blocks): (F1) an accidental extra bullet in orchestrator.md, (F2) a cross reference to a section title that does not exist (verdict-executor.md), (F3) the same in test-runner.md, (F4) a quotation of CLAUDE.md that no longer matches CLAUDE.md. Low remarks (L1-L6) do not block and are listed for the rework step. Per criterion of the task: (a) meaning - met, with one exception class (F2-F4: cross references changed); (b) headings, list items, tables, code blocks - met for 36 of 37 files, NOT met for orchestrator.md (list items 110 in the tag, 111 now: F1); (c) identifiers, AP/REQ/ISS/decision numbers, commands, field names, role codes - met (scripted, see self_check); (d) remaining Cyrillic - met: every Russian passage longer than one line is a quotation with an English gloss, none is plain Russian prose; a few Russian placeholders in commands have no gloss (L2); (e) plain English and glossary - met for the glossary terms of decisions/0080 item 5, but the same standard section headings and some terms are translated several ways across the three translation batches (L1, L4); (f) front matter - met: all 37 name: lines are unchanged and of the form "Sai <Role> (CODE)"; the handoff command reads the same 37 role codes as in the tag. Own full run of cd tools && npm run check in this turn: exit 1 with exactly the 11 known reds (HO-46, HO-47, HC-RT-1e, LG-10c, SF-6c, SU-10, SU-11, SV-1f, SV-7e, TR-4b, TR-4e), 1898 tests, 1887 pass, 0 skipped, 0 todo; prettier, eslint, traces and handoffs-check stages passed. Quality bar items (this is a documentation translation run with no code and no requirement): Q1 not applicable (no requirement, requirement_ids is empty); Q2 PASS (own comparison and own check run, not the step reports); Q3 PASS (every statement above has a command or a read behind it; the one thing not checked is the correctness of Kazakh or Russian texts, which are out of scope); Q4 PASS (single check command ran in my turn, only the 11 known reds); Q5 not applicable (no new logic); Q6 PASS for the role files (no check weakened here; the tests are the scope of step 07c); Q7 PASS (npm run traces is part of check and passed, no secrets or computer paths found in the 37 files); Q8, Q9, Q10, Q11 not applicable (no product code); Q12 PASS (the run follows decisions/0080; the additions in L3 are the only places where wording goes beyond the original and they are consistent with decisions/0080 item 3); Q13 not applicable to my scope (no new process mistake recorded by me; see I3); Q14 PASS for the role files (step handoffs 01-03 list the files; bookkeeping of the run is checked by step 07c/ORCH); R1 PASS (no merge done, PASS/FAIL here is not permission to merge); R2 PASS (no Pixel Office events written); R3 not applicable (decision 0033).

findings.where: All 37 files, standard section headings (batches of steps 01, 02, 03)
findings.evidence: The same three Russian headings are translated three ways: «Что сдать» = 'What to hand over' (14 files, step 01) / 'What to hand in' (10 files, step 02) / 'What to deliver' (13 files, step 03); «Проверка перед сдачей» = 'Check before handing over' (14) / 'Check before handing in' (10) / 'Check before delivery' (13); «Что прочитать перед работой» = 'What to read before work' (27) / 'What to read before working' (10). Other repeated rules differ in the same way by batch: «Граница с» = 'Boundary with' (13 files) / 'Border with' (ba-analyst, code-fixer, design-qa-validator, code-design-validator); 'unstable test' (orchestrator.md line 144, issue-fixer.md line 52) vs 'flaky test' (release-finalizer, test-runner, test-fixer) for the same rule of decisions/0079 item 2; 'grade' (doc-updater.md line 75) vs 'score' (audit-compiler) for «оценка»; step 02 files use ' - ' and US spelling ('behavior'), steps 01 and 03 use ' — ' and UK spelling ('behaviour'); he/she/it for a role differs between files ('He' in audit-*, ba-analyst, backend-dev; 'It' in doc-updater, idea-*, market-researcher, plan-*). No test reads these headings (tools/test has no match), so nothing is red, but a reader of two files sees two names for one section.
findings.fix: Pick one wording per heading and per term and apply it to all 37 files (suggested: 'What to hand in', 'Check before handing in', 'What to read before work', 'Boundary with', 'flaky', 'score'). Not blocking.
